title: East Maui ditch system ownership and county takeover bid
summary: BLNR staff concluded the county was not qualified to take over and run the East Maui irrigation system and recommended a long-term water license for Mahi Pono, but the board voted unanimously to deny that recommendation, which the vice chair said keeps alive the county's effort through the East Maui Water Authority. Presenters at several meetings questioned whether a private company or the state owns the system, citing old licenses that said the aqueducts revert to the government and a state letter saying the land department does not own it, while state staff cited the company's ownership of one ditch section to reject the county's request.
